findings.finding: FITCHI2 excludes CHI2INI prior terms included in minimization; comparing exported FITCHI2 alone is not comparing the full per-iteration minimand.
Peak penalty uses PEAKMJD minus INIVAL(IPAR_PEAKMJD), not directly the original photometry-header peak.
For later iterations INIVAL is previous-iteration FITVAL plus FITERR times INIVAL_SHIFT_ERRFRAC (default zero). Thus the peak-penalty center changes during the fitting sequence.
INIVAL_SHIFT_ERRFRAC defaults to zero; full/free/B log also records zero.

implication: Preserve the native algorithm as a conditional pipeline comparator, but do not label it a fixed-header Gaussian-prior posterior or rank different iteration states by exported data chi-square alone. A stable scientific profile needs a fixed measurement mask, stated covariance treatment and actual objective.
